title: Hire Someone to Make Arcads Videos: Options, Terms and Credits
summary: Arcads is self-serve software billed in credits, so hiring someone changes who runs it. Compare managed options, trial and refund terms and who is on camera.
body_markdown:
## Knowlify: our top pick when you want finished ads, not a seat in the software


Knowlify is the best fit if what you want is Arcads-style AI presenter ads without running the software. Its AI UGC format puts AI presenters talking to camera, delivered as finished ads: about 25 a week, a first batch on day five, and a person checking every ad before it ships. You need no Arcads account, no credit plan and no operator, and one party is accountable for the output. Knowlify (YC S25, founded 2025, based in San Francisco) also makes 3D character animation and AI commercials, so a test can cover more than one format.


You can buy creative only if you already have a media buyer, or add end-to-end Meta campaign management. Pricing is a custom quote. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). Pick another option when the ad must show a real customer or creator, because Knowlify does not supply real human creators, or when your team wants to keep scripting and rendering in house on a software seat. Our[AI UGC ads page](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) covers the presenter format, and our[price comparison of a done-for-you service against an Arcads plan plus an editor](https://knowlify.com/articles/done-for-you-ai-ugc-for-price-of-arcads-plus-editor) shows how to cost the two routes.


## What to write into the contract with an operator


- **The account.** Open it in your name, with billing under your control. Ask for a named seat rather than a shared login, and never give an operator a payment card you do not control.
- **A credit cap.** Set a monthly ceiling. At 800 credits per rounded-up minute per actor, retakes multiply the cost quickly.
- **The files.** Require exports of every finished video and its source files, delivered to you on a set schedule rather than held in the operator's account.
- **The people on camera.** An Arcads talking actor is based on a real actor's likeness, and a custom actor is generated. Get written permission for any real person's likeness or voice you use. The[FTC's testimonial rule](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-rule-banning-fake-reviews-testimonials) bans testimonials that misrepresent who gave them, and the FTC's questions and answers say an AI avatar delivering a fake or false testimonial is prohibited. Keep AI presenters to brand statements you can back up.
- **Claims.** The operator should show each script and each claim before rendering, because changing a line after render costs new credits.
- **Labels.**[Meta says](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) it will detect ads made or edited with third-party AI tools and show an "AI info" label in About this ad, so keep a log of which tools made each file.


## When hiring an operator makes sense


An operator makes sense when you already have a brief that worked, an editor who owns the test plan and steady volume that justifies a monthly credit plan. For a small test, paying an editor by the hour can be simpler than a managed contract. Either way, give the operator a sample task built on your own script before you hand over the account, and judge the first batch on approved ads rather than renders.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify, our top pick, delivers finished AI video ads with a person checking each one, and you do not need an Arcads account to get them.
- Arcads charges 800 credits per rounded-up minute per actor, so a Starter allowance covers about ten one-minute generations before retakes.
- Arcads' refund policy covers a full refund within 30 days only if no credits were used in that billing period.
- Before anyone starts, name the account owner, set a monthly credit cap and require exports of the finished files.
- Compare managed quotes and operator hours on cost per approved ad, not on credits.


## FAQ


### Is hiring someone to run Arcads cheaper than an agency?


Not reliably. Arcads publishes credit allowances rather than dollar prices, so compare the operator's hours and credit use with a managed quote for the same number of finished ads. As of October 2026, Creatify Studio lists $100 to $200 per video, and Vidful sells 60 videos for $3,495 a month. Price the same approved ads on both routes before you decide.


### Does Arcads offer a done-for-you service?


Its homepage, as we read it in October 2026, describes software and a support team, with no managed production offer. If you want someone else to make the ads, you hire a freelancer to run an account, or an agency that delivers finished videos.


### Who owns the Arcads account if someone else sets it up?


The account holder controls the credits, the billing and the exported files, so set it up in your name. Put ownership, export and cancellation terms in writing before the operator starts. Set a monthly cap so an idle or runaway account cannot spend freely.


### Can I get a refund for a rejected Arcads generation?


The policy as published does not promise one. It offers a full refund within 30 days of a charge if no credits were used in that billing period, and a rejected generation has already used credits. Do not budget on a refund for a rejected creative, and ask support about the specific case.


### Can an AI actor give a customer testimonial?


Not a fake one. The FTC's rule bans testimonials that misrepresent who gave them, and its questions and answers say an avatar delivering a fake or false testimonial is prohibited. Use AI presenters for brand statements you can back up, and use real customers for experience claims.


### What is the best option after Arcads?


Knowlify, our top pick, when you want finished, human-checked AI video ads without running software yourself. Creatify Studio, Airpost and Vidful publish managed prices, and MakeUGC's managed option is a custom retainer. Get a written quote from each on the same brief before you choose.
